# Structure Studios Blog

> A comprehensive resource for 3D design software updates, features, and best practices for pool and landscape design professionals.

Structure Studios publishes regular updates and guides for their suite of professional outdoor living design tools including Pool Studio, VizTerra, and Vip3D. The blog covers software releases, design techniques, and industry insights for landscape architects and pool designers.

## Key Topics

- Pool Studio
- VizTerra
- Vip3D
- 3D Design Software
- Pool Design
- Landscape Design
- Ray Tracing
- Dynamic Water
- Design Tools
- Software Features
- 3D Rendering
- Product Updates
- Hardscape Design
- Augmented Reality
- Design for Story

## Major Software Releases

- [Welcome to Version 4: The Next Evolution in Professional Outdoor Living Design](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/new-version4-vip3d-poolstudio-vizterra-update): Version 4 release with scale controls, pool floor design, coping grid, and 400+ plants.
- [Version 3: Next-Level 3D](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/version-3-outdoor-living-design-software-next-level-3d-is-here): Version 3 release: stunning 3D technology with improved rendering and performance.
- [Version 2 Summer 2021: Level Terrain, GIS Previews, and Property Lines](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/version-2-summer-2021-update): Version 2 update: level terrain tools, GIS previews, property line features.

## Annual Software Updates

- [2024 Update: Enhance Your Productivity with the Latest Tools](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/2024-update-vip3d-pool-landscape-design-software): 2024 software update: scale controls, pool floor design, hardscape grid, tint system.
- [2023 Update: Streamline Your Workflow with New Tools and 1400 New Assets](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/2023-update-vip3d-pool-landscape-design-software): 2023 update: Smart Snaps, design tools, gizmo, camera redesign, 1400 new assets.
- [Summer 2022: The Sky's the Limit with New Sky, House, and Roof Tools](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/summer-2022-automatic-roof-tools-light-controls-volumetric-clouds): Summer 2022 update: automatic roof tools, volumetric clouds, lighting controls.
- [Summer 2021: Ray Tracing, Dynamic Water, and Expanded Library](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/summer-2021-ray-tracing-dynamic-water-and-expanded-library): Summer 2021 update: ray tracing, dynamic water, expanded asset library.

## Design Features & Techniques

- [Create Incredible Hardscapes Faster with Custom Coping and Scoring Lines](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/hardscapes-with-custom-coping-and-custom-scoring-lines): Hardscape design features: custom coping and scoring modes for faster design.
- [Spring 2020: Ellipses, Angled Windows and New Fence & Railing Options](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/spring-2020-update-ellipses-angled-windows-and-new-fence-and-railing-options): Spring 2020 update: ellipses, angled windows, fence and railing design tools.
- [Fall 2019 Update: Pitched Pergolas, Auto Contour Lines, and Spell Check](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/fall-2019-update-pitched-pergolas-automatic-contour-lines-and-spell-check): Fall 2019 update: pitched pergolas, automatic contour lines, spell check tool.
- [Summer 2019 Update: Point Heights, Four New Drawing Tools and More](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/summer-2019-update-custom-point-heights-four-new-drawing-tools-and-faster-staircases): Summer 2019 update: point heights, four new drawing tools, smart staircase design.
- [Fall 2018 Update: Carvings, Pool Lips, and Pool Coves](https://blog.structurestudios.com/software/fall-2018-update-carvings-pool-lips-and-pool-coves): Fall 2018 update: carvings, pool lips, pool coves for detailed pool design.
